leadStory.headline: The Smell of Fresh Ash: Total Meltdowns and Fraudulent Miracles Define Week 2
leadStory.content: Welcome back to the weekly inferno. If you smell burning flesh and scorched pride, do not panic—it is merely the sacred ritual of 'горіння' consuming fantasy owners across the league. Nothing encapsulates our shared mental illness quite like Week 2: Fantaser drops a solid 130.64 points only to get completely obliterated by Rookie39's spontaneous thermonuclear detonation of 163.92. Meanwhile, Dankom completely forgot how to play football, crashing down to earth with an abysmal 91.46 points in the week's most grotesque massacre courtesy of Hlopchik. You spent hours analyzing depth charts and waiver wires just for the cruel fantasy gods to roast your hopes over an open spit. Crack open a cold beverage to soothe the third-degree burns, because the agony has only begun.

matchups.recap: The textbook definition of fantasy heartbreak. Fantaser put up a roster capable of beating almost anyone else in the league, only to run face-first into Rookie39's unholy buzzsaw of 163.92 points. Enjoy the pure, unadulterated rage of losing while scoring 130.

echoCloud remains relentless and undefeated, leaving Olegi to curse at the ceiling as another respectable week went up in smoke. It was a grind, but echoCloud had just enough juice to keep the furnace stoked.

An absolute crime scene of a matchup. Both managers threw up mid performances, but TigersFlames found a way to lose by less than four points, securing an 0-2 start while dawg8 stumbled blindly into a win.

A 63.8-point public execution. Hlopchik went full scorched-earth mode, while Dankom's squad flatlined with the week's lone sub-century score. The stench of Dankom's bench and starters alike will linger for weeks.

Chivascat put up a spirited fight with 127.28 points, which in typical fantasy fashion only served to make the defeat hurt twice as much against snickone's balanced onslaught. Chivascat slides to 0-2, surrounded by flames.
janitorQA took out the trash this week, mopping the floor with j4wsomeD who looked thoroughly disinterested in fielding a competitive lineup. An easy, painless win in an otherwise painful week.
Living up to the inverse of their name, Easybeat handed ArtemC a comfortable thrashing. ArtemC's roster sputtered out early, leaving their manager staring blankly at the waiver wire in despair.

awards.honorRoll: Rookie39 exploded for a week-high 163.92 points, ruthlessly vaporizing Fantaser and setting the league scoring benchmark with extreme prejudice.
awards.detention: Dankom takes the walk of shame after scraping together an embarrassing 91.46 points, earning the title of lone sub-100 dumpster fire of Week 2.
awards.fraudWatch: dawg8 is somehow 2-0 despite sitting 10th overall in total points (234.34) and scraping past TigersFlames in an ugly slugfest. Regression is coming with a flamethrower.

powerRankings.blurb: Sitting at 2-0 with a league-best 321.94 points, their owners are enjoying the view while everyone else burns alive.
